    def get_files_diff(self, current_files_path_strs: set[str], prior_files_stat_by_path: dict[str, FileStat]) -> FilesDiff:
        """Split files into: changed (added/updated), unchanged, deleted"""

        # * ignored files

        # * added, modified (aka changed)

            if is_new_file:
